definitions.explanation: The quality of treating everyone equally without favoritism or bias.

examples.japanese: ⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{公平性|こうへいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧。
examples.english: To maintain fairness in the evaluation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{税制|ぜいせい}→税制：28854_zeisei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{公平性|こうへいせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The fairness of the tax system has become an issue.

examples.japanese: {公平性|こうへいせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|くだ}す→下す：12329_kudasu⟧。

notes:
{公平性|こうへいせい} is an abstract noun meaning the quality of being fair or impartial, formed from {公平|こうへい} (fair) + {性|せい} (nature/quality).

FORMS:
The suffix 〜{性|せい} creates abstract nouns from adjectives: ⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧ → ⟦{重要性|じゅうようせい}→重要性：04823_juuyousei⟧ (importance), ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧ → ⟦{安全性|あんぜんせい}→安全性：19384_anzensei⟧ (safety).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公平性|こうへいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}する→確保：13681_kakuho⟧: to ensure fairness
- {公平性|こうへいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to maintain fairness
- {公平性|こうへいせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧: to lack fairness
- {公平性|こうへいせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問|と}われる→問う：02299_tou⟧: fairness is questioned

USAGE:
Common in formal contexts like legal proceedings, hiring processes, and policy discussions. The simpler ⟦{公平|こうへい}→公平：01648_kouhei⟧ (na-adjective) is used for direct descriptions: ⟦{公平|こうへい}な→公平：01648_kouhei⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧ (a fair judgment).
